campaigns.intro: Every account’s sponsored LINE campaigns — totals only, no recipient data. Stop a campaign whose content or policy fails review: messages not yet sent are cancelled and nothing is billed.
campaigns.emptyHint: Campaigns appear here from draft to sent.
campaigns.rejectBody: By {tenant} · Messages not yet sent are cancelled and the campaign is not billed. The account sees the reason you give.
campaigns.reasonHint: The account sees this — say clearly what must change
campaigns.invalidState: This campaign has already finished or ended and cannot be stopped

settings.title: Sponsored LINE broadcasts
settings.description: The service switch, frequency, quiet hours and the consent text. Every changed value becomes a new version from now, with a reason — never backdated.
settings.onBody: Accounts can schedule campaigns; the job sends every minute in turn.
settings.offBody: Accounts can draft and estimate, but cannot schedule, and nothing is sent. Switch it on only with LINE Thailand’s written confirmation (O-023).
settings.consentingHint: At the current text version (total only)
settings.confirmLine: LINE Thailand confirmed in writing, and the evidence is named in the reason below
settings.confirmLineRequired: Confirm LINE Thailand’s written confirmation before switching it on
settings.quietHint: Used when a recipient has not set their own
settings.sendWindowHint: A campaign closes this long after it starts (1–168)
settings.attributionHint: Enquiries by recipients within this many days count for the campaign (1–60)
settings.deliveryKeepHint: Afterwards only the campaign totals remain (1–36)
settings.consentQuotes: The consent text quotes the weekly limit and the keep periods — publish a new text version when you change them.
settings.reasonHint: Recorded on every changed value, e.g. LINE’s confirmation e-mail and its date, or the pilot’s results

consent.title: Consent text
consent.description: What people read before opting in to recommendations (platform.recommendations), in Thai and English
consent.publishBody: Once in force, everyone must opt in again; until they do, nobody receives recommendations.
consent.publishWarning: {count, plural, one {# person consents now — they will be asked again} other {# people consent now — all will be asked again}}
consent.legal: Have counsel review the text before every version
consent.bodyTh: รายละเอียด (ไทย)
consent.bodyHint: Markdown: purpose, data used, the profiling note and how to stop
consent.effectiveFromHint: Empty = now. Thailand time, never backdated
